purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.content: These terms aim to regulate the conditions and procedures for using the Winnie service provided by My Winnie Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as 'Company'), as well as the rights, obligations, and responsibilities between the Company and members.

definitions.title: Definitions
definitions.content:
• 'Service' refers to the membership marketplace platform provided by the Company.
• 'Member' refers to a person who has registered and uses the Service.
• 'Seller' refers to a business operator who sells memberships through the Service.

terms.title: Effectiveness and Amendment of Terms
terms.content: These terms apply to all members who wish to use the Service. The Company may amend these terms when necessary within the scope of applicable laws.

services.title: Provision of Services
services.content:
The services provided by the Company include:
• Membership product search and information provision
• Transaction mediation between sellers and members
• Membership management service
• Other services determined by the Company

membership.title: Membership Registration
membership.content: Those who wish to use the Service apply for membership by entering member information according to the registration form set by the Company and expressing their consent to these terms.

obligations.title: Member Obligations
obligations.content:
Members must not engage in the following activities:
• Identity theft
• Interfering with normal service operation
• Collecting personal information of other members
• Other activities that violate laws or good morals

transactions.title: Transactions and Payments
transactions.content: Winnie service mediates direct transactions between members and sellers. Payments are made directly to sellers, and the Company does not charge platform fees.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: The Company acts only as an intermediary for transactions between members and sellers, and liability for transactions rests with the parties involved.

disputes.title: Dispute Resolution
disputes.content: Korean law applies to disputes arising from the use of the Service, and the Seoul Central District Court shall have jurisdiction.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: My Winnie Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as 'Company') values user privacy and complies with the Personal Information Protection Act.

collection.title: Personal Information Collected
collection.content:
The Company collects the following personal information for service provision:
• Required: Email address, password, nickname
• Optional: Profile photo, phone number
• Automatically collected: Device information, service usage records, access IP information

purpose.title: Purpose of Collection and Use
purpose.content:
• Service provision and operation
• Member management and identity verification
• Service improvement and new service development
• Marketing and advertising use (with consent)

retention.title: Retention and Use Period
retention.content: The Company destroys personal information without delay after the purpose of collection and use has been achieved. However, information may be retained for a certain period if required by relevant laws.

sharing.title: Provision to Third Parties
sharing.content: The Company does not provide user personal information to third parties in principle. However, exceptions apply when user consent is obtained or when required by law.

rights.title: User Rights
rights.content: Users may view or modify their personal information at any time and request to cancel their membership.

security.title: Security Measures
security.content: The Company implements technical and administrative measures such as encryption, access restrictions, and security software installation to ensure the security of personal information.

contact.title: Privacy Officer
contact.content:
The Company designates a privacy officer to oversee personal information processing and handle user complaints and damage relief.

• Privacy Officer: My Winnie Co., Ltd. CEO
• Contact: winnie@yeowubie.com
